evidence_target: one real verifier-triggered ROLLBACK_SUCCESS plus the existing no-rollback outcomes

controlled_condition.name: CONTROLLED_SOURCE_FAILURE_WITH_REAL_SERVICE_MATRIX_VERIFIER_CONTENTION
controlled_condition.smallest_sufficient_reason: The controlled source creates a genuine one-user failover Candidate; one bounded existing-owner service-matrix refresh contention makes the normal verifier return a real lock-timeout failure, which must be observed by the normal Runtime rollback decision instead of calling rollback directly.
preparation: Move only 10.7.0.16 from vless to the controlled certification source through the existing assignment owner; classify this setup movement as ENGINEERING_SETUP_NOT_EVIDENCE.
Mark the existing source certification scope for only 10.7.0.16 through tools/v7-egress-set-state.
Prove source, target, route, service, capacity, Safe Mode, restore barrier and rollback readiness before opening the incident.
activation: Mark only wireguard-1779454504-c43409 maintenance through tools/v7-egress-set-state --controlled-certification.
Require the normal planner to select exactly 10.7.0.16 and exactly target vless; every other selection is STOP_SAFE.
Start one normal tools/v7-service-matrix-refresh-all lifecycle invocation so the real service-matrix lock is held during the bounded verifier window.

After terminal forward-route acknowledgement to vless and before the verifier timeout, restore wireguard-1779454504-c43409 to enabled through tools/v7-egress-set-state so the registered rollback destination is healthy.
Let tools/v7-service-matrix-test independently return service_matrix_lock_timeout and let tools/v7-users-autoswitch decide whether rollback is required.
controlled_condition.registered_rollback_trigger: required_service_verify_timeout after successful bounded forward apply and exact selected-user route acknowledgement

freshness_and_binding_gates: CPS still names rollback_and_no_rollback_present and this exact request as the controlled-lane frontier.
Request is unexpired and has not been consumed.
Local, GitHub and production commit/runtime snapshot remain aligned.
Certification-user, source, target, policy, topology and owner identities match this contract; any semantic drift returns to R1/R2.
Admin Safe Mode is OPEN and no real customer recovery, conflicting incident, active lease or restore-barrier operation exists.
The controlled source and vless target pass fresh route and required-service checks before deliberate activation.
A fresh Situation, Decision Trace, Candidate, Packet, approval identity, serial lease and transaction nonce are atomically bound before apply.
Duplicate consumption, changed subject/source/target/condition or partial binding fails closed.
stop_safe_abort_containment_cleanup: Abort before setup or apply on any stale binding, non-vless target, ordinary-user selection, capacity/quality regression, active production recovery, Authority ambiguity or cleanup-owner failure.
Real customer recovery preempts the certification run and receives the service-matrix/Runtime resources.
If apply state becomes ambiguous or rollback fails, enter the existing fail-safe/incident path and grant no optimistic evidence.

Release any service-matrix lifecycle operation, restore the controlled source enabled, restore 10.7.0.16 to its initial vless assignment, verify table 1014 and required services, close lease/packet/restore identities, and finish Admin Safe Mode OPEN.
Preserve append-only evidence even when the intended trigger or terminal is not reached.
